concept: A heartfelt thank-you hug and flowers between generations at home

generation.description: In a warmly lit kitchen-dining space, a younger woman in an olive top hugs an older gray-haired woman while offering a kraft-paper bouquet of sunflowers, daisies, yellow filler blooms, and eucalyptus, her eyes closed in a joyful, grateful smile. Soft daylight, wooden surfaces, a mug, plants, and gently blurred kitchen details create an intimate, lived-in backdrop that highlights the tender family-like moment.
